{{Infobox Slayer |name = Smoke devils |icon = [[File:Smoke devil icon.png|center]] |skillreq = {{SCP|Slayer|93}} |combatreq = {{SCP|Combat|85}} |otherreq = None |konar = 120-170 |nieve = 120-185 |duradel = 130-200 |mortimer = 80-120 (130-220) |id = 5349 }} [[Smoke devil]]s can be assigned as a [[slayer task]] at level 93 [[Slayer]] and level 85 [[combat]] by high-end [[Slayer master]]s. They are only found in the [[Smoke Devil Dungeon]] south of [[Castle Wars]] and can '''only''' be fought if on a task. They attack with [[magical ranged]]. As with [[dust devil]]s, players '''must''' wear a [[facemask]] or [[slayer helm]] when fighting smoke devils, or their attacks will always deal moderate damage that also drains stats. Players may choose between killing smoke devils or their boss variant, the [[thermonuclear smoke devil]]. When killing normal smoke devils, players are highly encouraged to use barrage spells, as smoke devils have a high defence level. Although they have very high magic defence, they have a low magic level, which means most spells will still be reasonably accurate. A cannon is strongly recommended to lure the smoke devils, as their cave is extremely large and trying to stack them without one is significantly slower. Players who have obtained rewards from the elite tier of [[Combat Achievements]] should have enough cannonballs for one rotation to lure all the smoke devils, while those without may need to reload their cannon once to do so. Place the cannon in the centre of the dungeon and stack the smoke devils as they aggro, using the remains to the sides to stack them. Restore the stack when three or fewer smoke devils are left. When killing the boss, players can opt between melee or magic. Magic is faster but more expensive, while melee is less cost but requires more attention. If players wish to maximise profit from the task, killing the boss is recommended. If seeking to quickly clear the task or obtain the [[imbued heart]]/[[eternal gem]], kill normal smoke devils instead. Their superior, the [[nuclear smoke devil]], has a fairly high chance of rolling the table, second only to the [[Colossal Hydra]]. ==Slayer Unlocks== {{Main|Slayer reward point}} {|class="wikitable sortable lighttable align-left-2 align-left-4" style="text-align:center;" !class="unsortable"| !Unlock !Points cost !Notes |- |[[File:Bigger and Badder.png|link=]] |Bigger and Badder |50 |Increase the risk against certain slayer monsters with the chance of a [[Superior slayer monster|superior version]] spawning whilst on a slayer task. |} ==Monster Variants== {|class = "wikitable sortable" !Monster !Combat level !Slayer XP !Locations !Notes |- |[[Smoke devil]] |160 |185 | *[[Smoke Devil Dungeon]] | * Standard smoke devil. |- |[[Nuclear smoke devil]] |280 |2,400 | *[[Smoke Devil Dungeon]] | * [[Superior slayer monster]] variant, which has a chance of spawning on a Smoke devil's death after purchasing the ''Bigger and Badder'' unlock for 50 [[Slayer reward point]]s from any [[Slayer master]]. |- |[[Thermonuclear smoke devil]] |301 |240 | *[[Smoke Devil Dungeon]] | *A [[boss]] monster found in its lair in the [[Smoke Devil Dungeon]]. *For more information on fighting the [[Thermonuclear smoke devil]], see [[Thermonuclear smoke devil/Strategies]]. |} ==Location Comparison== {|class = "wikitable sortable align-center-3" !Location !Maplink !Amount !Multicombat !Cannonable !Safespottable !Notes |- |[[Smoke Devil Dungeon]] |{{Map|type=maplink |name = Smoke devil |location = [[Smoke Devil Dungeon]] |ptype = monster |levels = 160 |mapID = 27 |2351,9448|2354,9455|2358,9445|2367,9455|2368,9442|2370,9449|2380,9429|2382,9458|2382,9465|2383,9444|2384,9434|2384,9452|2390,9459|2391,9422|2391,9443|2393,9437|2395,9450|2396,9430|2398,9442|2399,9459|2401,9421|2402,9448|2404,9454|2405,9438|2406,9433|2409,9461|2410,9452|2412,9421|2412,9427|2413,9433|2413,9444|2417,9455|2419,9424|2419,9435|2421,9460|2422,9448|2360,9452 |mtype = pin }} |36 Smoke devils
